name: Masala Steak with Cardamom Root Veggies, Goat Cheese & Pistachios
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a small bowl.
Add goat cheese to the bowl with the basil; set aside to soften.

Peel, trim, and slice carrots and parsnips crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Transfer both to a large baking sheet pan, season with cardamom and salt, then stir to combine. Spread out in an even layer.

Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't need to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.

Once the pan is hot, coat with butter. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, use the back of a spoon to mash and combine the basil-goat cheese. Set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top veggies with basil-goat cheese and pistachios. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
